text: 1-7 Sāvatthi || || Samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī [page 277] XXXIV. 55. 6] JHĀNA-SAṂYUTTA 277 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || || Samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī hoti na samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo || || Neva samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo hoti na samādhismim sakkaccakārī || || Samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī ca || || 8-9 Tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī || pa || uttamo pavaro cā ti || ||
